description: Fetch one PaliAnswers claim by its id or slug, for example one listed by list_claims; give exactly one of id or slug. Returns the claim with PIPD's full answers, sources, themes and page URL.

id.description: Claim id, as returned by the other tools.

slug.description: Claim slug: the last part of its page URL, e.g. the slug in /myths/<slug>/.

name: get_claim

answers.description: PIPD's answers to the claim, in markdown.

claim.description: The claim or myth, as PIPD phrases it.

match.description: search_claims only: strong when the score is at least 0.70.

sources.description: PIPD's sources, as markdown citations with links.

url.description: The claim's page on PaliAnswers. Cite and link it.

title: Get a PaliAnswers claim
